metadata.title: Stability of Hyperplane Projections of the Regular Simplex and $L_p$-Projection Bodies of balls in $\ell_q^n(\mathbb{R})$
metadata.abstract: We prove stability estimates for extremal hyperplane projections of the regular simplex. We further generalize the analogous stability estimates for $\ell_q$-balls by the first named author and the monotonicity theorem for normalized ratios by Barthe and Naor to the $L_p$-setting. To this end, we derive closed formulas for the support functions of their $L_p$-projection bodies, complementing those obtained by the second named author. A key ingredient in our proofs is a stability refinement of the majorization inequality for Gaussian mixtures.

analysis.workSummary: 证明正单纯形极值超平面投影的稳定估计，并将 lq 球相关稳定性和归一化比值单调性推广到 Lp 投影体，通过支撑函数公式及 Gaussian mixture 的 majorization 稳定改进实现。
analysis.breakthrough: 把极值投影定理提升为定量偏离控制。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方摘要和作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读完整证明。具体 p、q 范围及误差常数未在摘要中列全，不能宣称任意凸体的同类稳定性。 AI 披露另见独立全文核查。
